sources.title: RFD4-Proteina — RFD4-Proteina documentation
sources.snippet: A next generation sequence structure codesign model for proteins, RNA, DNA, and small molecule complexes. Capable of satisfying robust conditioning and generating plausible sequences without further refinement. Developed by the Baker Lab × NVIDIA GenAIR, with the Institute for Protein Design at the University of Washington.

sources.title: GitHub - RosettaCommons/RFD4-Proteina: Generative protein design with ...
sources.snippet: RFD4-Proteina designs proteins and biomolecular complexes with sequence-structure co-design, motif and binding-site conditioning, partial diffusion, and reward-guided search. Key features: Many design tasks from one model: monomers, protein and DNA binders, antibodies and nanobodies, enzymes and motif scaffolding, small-molecule pockets.
